name: Mocktail 1.0.4
body:
## What's new?

- Fixed login issues
- Fixed low-resolution textures, skybox rendering and HiDPI scaling.
- Added vc support.
- Added Xbox and PlayStation gamepad support.
- Added Nix support
- Improved text input, fullscreen mode, window sizing, and mouse controls.
- Updated support for Roblox 2.736.1408.

name: Mocktail 1.0.3
body:
- Fixed issues with downloading Roblox on first launch
- Added `fflags.json` for custom FFlags
- Added a message if your cookies have expired
- Added experimental support for FreeBSD 15.1 using Linuxulator
- Removed automatic cookie import from Sober due to security concerns (this applies only to native versions)

name: Mocktail 1.0.2
body:
- Fixed the “Roblox is out of date” bug
- Improved logging
- Fixed issues with Discord RPC where the game you were playing wasn’t displayed
- Added APT and RPM repositories with stable and nightly packages

name: Mocktail 1.0.1
body:
- Fix issues with GameMode
- Add Discord RPC support

name: Mocktail 0.1.0
body: First stable release after 2 months of work
